description: This PHP class EmpEmergencyContactDecorator is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the plugin architecture under the Decorator namespace. It provides a decorator for the EmpEmergencyContact entity, adding methods to enhance its functionality, such as associating an employee via employee number. It interacts with core ORM traits and other entities like Employee.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmpEmergencyContact entity, providing additional methods such as linking an employee by employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting an EmpEmergencyContact entity instance.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped EmpEmergencyContact entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the emergency contact based on the provided employee number.
